title: Online step 1: online updates with the task loss only (no online auxiliary gate-entropy term)
exploratory_disclosure: Exploratory; the seed-2 test period has been used seven times.
reference: round 6 (a0e15, online lr 3e-5, online loss = task + gate-entropy auxiliary, round-5 gate) as the online starting point; round 5 (lr 0 + gate) as the fixed control
single_change: online loss = task loss only; offline checkpoint a0e15, rate 3e-5, feedback, maturity rule, gate (gs 0.9, mu 0) unchanged
hypothesis: online updates are partly driven by the gate-entropy auxiliary gradient (median aux/task gradient-norm ratio on validation: SocialGood 1.08, Economy 0.66), which is not aligned with the forecasting target
candidate_note: r5 = lr0 adapter; r6 = lr3e-5 with auxiliary; taskonly = lr3e-5 without auxiliary; second element = gate
selection: seed-2 validation r=0 (entry seed 200); robust score = max(whole GM, largest per-third GM) of the CVaR90 ratio to iTransformer over 36 tasks; argmin; ties toward r5+gate, then listed order
reporting: pre-gate and post-gate scores, adapter share, mean |updated - frozen| per candidate
test_use_policy: test computed only if the winner is a taskonly candidate with robust validation score <= 0.985
